operation_encoding.2'b10: AND: result is a bitwise-AND b
operation_encoding.2'b11: XOR: result is a bitwise-XOR b

flag_semantics.zero: one iff every result bit is zero, for every operation
flag_semantics.negative: the most-significant result bit, for every operation
flag_semantics.carry_add: the unsigned carry-out bit of a + b
flag_semantics.carry_sub: one means no unsigned borrow (a >= b); zero means borrow
flag_semantics.overflow_add: one iff a and b have the same sign and result has the opposite sign
flag_semantics.overflow_sub: one iff a and b have different signs and result has the opposite sign from a

acceptance.operation: all four op encodings are valid and evaluated continuously

liveness_boundary: This task is purely combinational; only functional safety/equivalence properties apply.
